title: EmoHopeSpeech: An Annotated Dataset of Emotions and Hope Speech in English and Arabic
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hope speech with a spiritual or religious component, categorized under 'Spiritual/Empowerment'.
findings: The study successfully created and annotated a 'Spiritual/Empowerment' subcategory of hope speech, defined as content inspired by religious or spiritual beliefs. This category was present in both English and Arabic data, with 'Spiritual Empowerment' and 'Solidarity/Peace' showing similar trends across both languages, though Arabic had higher overall counts.
